card.name: Urgent timing words in overdose treatment
card.fires_on: Words inside phrases about acting right away, such as "as soon as possible" or "immediately", in overdose or emergency treatment instructions.

modes.label: As soon as possible
modes.description: Words within the phrase "as soon as possible" after an overdose or missed treatment.
modes.example: Reduces acetaminophen absorption when administered as soon<< as>> possible after overdose.

modes.label: Urgent action wording
modes.description: Words that introduce or modify an urgent step such as stopping an infusion or giving a rescue treatment.
modes.example: If extravasation occurs, immediately<< dis>>continue the infusion, remove the infusion cath

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning instantly or immediately, so it likely holds back a repeated urgency word at these points.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of wording like "as soon as possible" or "immediately" in emergency and overdose instructions.
